# DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness with Function-Specific Training in Packaging & Labeling

> 5-hour online training on the DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR Parts 171-180, enforced by PHMSA), combining general awareness and security awareness with function-specific training in packaging, marking and labeling. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 5 hours; 2 modules, 12 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.5 CEU
- Price: $158.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years)
- Adds Specific Packaging and Specific Labeling lessons beyond the 4-hour General Awareness course

## Lessons
Module 1: Hazardous Materials Regulations
1. Regulatory Overview
2. Hazard Classes and Divisions
3. Hazardous Materials Table, Part 1
4. Hazardous Materials Table, Part 2
5. Preparation of Shipping Papers
Module 2: Packaging and Labeling
6. General Packaging Requirements
7. Specific Packaging Requirements
8. General Marking Requirements
9. General Labeling Requirements
10. Specific Labeling Requirements
11. General Placarding Requirements
12. Safety and Security Plans

## Who should take it
Shipper personnel offering hazmat in commerce; people who design, manufacture, inspect, maintain, recondition, repair or test hazmat packaging; anyone handling hazmat packages; people who mark or label packages; drivers responsible for hazmat in transit.
